Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) A specific workflow or pipeline phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate, heal). Name the workflow file or phase in your answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A specific script, prompt or helper under `scripts/` or `prompts/`. Name the file.
C) Documentation only (README, docs/, or an agents.d fragment). Name the document and section.
D) This issue was filed by mistake or as a test and should be closed with no change.
Q2: What does "better" mean for the area you chose in Q1?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. Link the failing run, PR or issue and describe the expected behavior. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Add a specific new capability. Describe the desired behavior and how to tell it works.
C) Improve a measurable property (runtime, API-call count, cost, alert noise). Name the metric and the target value.
D) Not decided yet: close this issue and file a new one once the goal is defined.
